Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class Exception4 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		int n = args.length;

		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
			if (args[i].charAt(args[i].length() - 1) == ',')
				args[i] = args[i].replace(",", "");

		int[] arr = new int[n];

		int sum = 0;
		double avg = 0;

		try {
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
				arr[i] = Integer.parseInt(args[i]);

			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
				sum += arr[i];

			avg = sum / n;
		} catch (Exception e) {
			System.out.println(e.getClass().getCanonicalName());
		}

		System.out.println("sum: " + sum);
		System.out.println("avg: " + avg);

	}
}
